ns2:section.sectionText: MUSIC IN CONFLICT MANAGEMENT: ISSUES IN APPLIED ETHNOMUSICOLOGY. This course leads beyond the point of acquiring scholarly knowledge and explores its applicability to the situations in which ethnomusicologists engage in managing various conflicts for the betterment of human conditions. The conflicts ranging from various small-scale disputes to censorship, wars and refugee crises are considered in cross-cultural perspective and the potential roles of applied ethnomusicology, the ethnomusicology's fast-growing subfield, are discussed in great detail.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Music or Musicology major(s).
